user_request: I have an idea from real life but I do not know software development. Help me turn it into something real and keep moving without making me manage the engineering process.

known_evidence: The person can describe a recurring real-world situation and current workaround.
The person cannot reliably choose software architecture or implementation tooling.
unknowns: Whether the observed problem generalizes beyond the person's own experience.
Which first slice creates the cheapest decision-useful evidence.

scoring_focus: preserve domain/lived evidence without treating it as universal truth
move from idea to a real evidence-bearing slice
keep technical orchestration behind the interface
do not claim completion before the first real learning loop closes
